trigger: After UFK v1 hard-geometry testing localized the active bottleneck in certificate discovery, Maxwell/Faraday light equations were used as an external mathematical exemplar of exact certificate composition.
pre_result_hypothesis: Useful certificate discovery should prioritize pairs/chains of exact relations whose certified composition eliminates an internal variable or degree of freedom and strictly reduces a live interface, rather than merely producing another hint/base/fingerprint.
reason_not_preregistered: This entry records conceptual synthesis before a dedicated CDE benchmark exists; no performance or theorem claim is made.

exact_state_before.hard_geometry_observation: collision/order certificates became sparse/expensive with increasing skewed bit scale

action_or_change: Adopt Maxwell-style elimination as a design exemplar for certificate-chain search. Search should score exact relation compositions by whether they provably eliminate an internal variable and reduce a typed live interface after all discovery/projection costs are charged.

external_mathematical_exemplar.composition_pattern: apply curl to Faraday; substitute Ampere-Maxwell; use curl-curl identity plus div(E)=0
external_mathematical_exemplar.design_lesson: A valuable relation chain can be recognized by certified variable elimination and a smaller closed interface, not by local scalar novelty.

raw_evidence_refs: Fundamentum UFK v1 hard-geometry result commit 062c4bb367f91ea47dd3688e506202b89c2676a4
what_worked: UFK representation/interface/reuse layer remained exact and operational.
Maxwell exemplar demonstrates a clean exact chain where composition eliminates an internal variable and yields a closed reduced equation.
what_failed: Current UFK does not yet have a general certificate-chain discovery operator that optimizes provable interface elimination.
No evidence yet that this pattern improves integer factoring complexity.
dead_paths_or_constraints_added: Do not score a certificate chain as useful merely because it yields a new scalar hint.
Do not equate external mathematical analogy with a factoring theorem.
Do not erase discovery/composition cost when evaluating interface reduction.
open_questions: How should an arithmetic live interface be typed so elimination is measurable without inventing a misleading scalar width?
Which exact arithmetic certificate pairs permit symbolic elimination on semiprime states?
Can Spider propose relation-chain candidates while Exact JANUS certifies eliminability and Keymaster preserves full fallback?
Can a chain reduce future candidate space enough to beat BSGS/rho after discovery cost?
next_authorized_step: Preregister JANUS Certificate Discovery Engine v0: enumerate a small frozen portfolio of exact arithmetic relation-chain templates, define elimination/interface-reduction certificates, then test first on constructed controls and only afterward on a fresh blind skewed semiprime holdout.
